text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad. Today is my 
long-awaited debut race."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Before the race, I was anxious about 
whether I could live up to all the fans' 
expectations, so my heart was pounding 
like crazy."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"But rememberin' how warmly everyone back 
in the village sent me off... I'm gonna 
make this an amazin' debut!"
